name: Dimistia
bio: Dimistia’s parents trained her to track Demons as soon as she could walk. The day the Knights of Malice came to her home, she learned why. Young Dimistia hid as she was trained to, but when she returned, it was all gone... except a Demon trail. A trail she had been trained all her life to follow.
